description: Repairs of Exhaust Stack at Sapugaskanda Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the above tender as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.  Cabinet also noted that no appeals have been received from the unsuccessful bidders.
